format: Each folder <id>/ holds manifest.json plus MP3 samples (44.1 kHz, LAME VBR V2; the stereo piano uses V3 to stay under 4 MB). Mono unless the manifest name says stereo (piano and vibraphone are stereo). Decoders that honour the LAME gapless header (Chrome, Firefox, ffmpeg) return sample-accurate audio, so loopStart/loopEnd (seconds) line up exactly; a decoder that ignores the header would add about 25 ms of leading silence.

manifestFields.samples[].midi: MIDI note the file sounds at (A440 equal temperament, verified within +-20 cents; piano keeps its natural stretch tuning)
manifestFields.samples[].vel: velocity layer the file represents; only the piano has two layers (48 soft, 96 loud)
manifestFields.samples[].loopStart/loopEnd: seamless sustain loop in seconds (crossfade already baked in, audio after loopEnd continues the loop so stopping the loop on note-off is click-free); null for one-shots
manifestFields.sustained: true for winds/brass: hold the loop while the key is down
manifestFields.gain: linear gain that matches this set's perceived loudness to the piano (piano = 1.0; K-weighted loudness of the first second, sustained sets 0.3-2 s)

bright_acoustic_piano.suggestion: Use the acoustic_grand_piano samples with a high-shelf boost (about +4 to +6 dB above 2.5 kHz) and a slightly faster release.

electric_guitar_jazz.suggestion: Dry DI source: clean amp/cab voicing with a darker EQ (low-pass ~2.5-3 kHz, slight mid scoop) and a softer attack.

electric_guitar_muted.suggestion: Clean voicing plus a fast amplitude decay (~0.15-0.3 s to silence) and a low-pass ~1.5-2 kHz for palm muting.

overdriven_guitar.suggestion: Crunch: moderate waveshaper / soft clip before a 4x12-style cab EQ (HPF ~90 Hz, LPF ~5 kHz).

distortion_guitar.suggestion: Drive: heavier pre-gain + clip before the cab EQ; the long natural sustain of the DI files suits high gain.

wah_wah_guitar.suggestion: Clean or crunch voicing through a resonant band-pass swept 400 Hz-2 kHz (envelope- or LFO-driven).

brass_section.reason: No properly licensed (CC0 / CC-BY / free-for-any-use) recorded brass-section multisample was found. VSCO-2 CE, VCSL and the University of Iowa MIS only have solo brass; the free section libraries found are NonCommercial, 'no redistribution' or have no clear license.
brass_section.suggestion: Layer the delivered trumpet + trombone + french_horn sets (e.g. trumpet at the played pitch, trombone an octave below, horn at the played pitch; detune the layers 3-8 cents and offset their attacks by 5-15 ms).

clavinet.reason: No properly licensed recorded clavinet multisample was found: the free clavinet SoundFonts found have no license statement, and the sampled-clavinet libraries found (Scarbee, Soniccouture, Acousticsamples Clavi D9, Rhodes Clav Pro) are commercial. The Discord SFZ GM Bank's clavinet slot is an empty placeholder.
clavinet.suggestion: Synthesize it (plucked-string / Karplus-Strong or a bright pulse wave with a fast-decaying resonant low-pass and a short 'clack' noise at note-on; release must mute quickly, 60-100 ms).
